transferDescription: The card leaves the list of @{{from}} and goes to @{{to}}. The history records the transfer.
withdrawDescription: This closes the request for everyone and tells the agent it is out of date. It is not an approval. You cannot undo it.
withdrawReasonPlaceholder: Why is it out of date? (optional, shown in history and to the agent)
withdrawStaleDescription: Each request closes for everyone and its agent is told it is out of date. None of them counts as approved. You cannot undo this.
forOthers: {{count}} of these are for other people. Continue?
stayOpenRequired: Stay open: required, withdraw one at a time
stayOpenNoRequest: Stay open: no request to withdraw
staleReasonPlaceholder: Why are they out of date? (optional, shown in history and to the agents)
